name: verify
description: Test a provider's connection by creating a TRANSIENT LlmProvider with the supplied (unsaved) config and probing its /v1/models (or provider-equivalent) endpoint. Returns the model list + verification metadata on success, or `{success:false, errorCode, error}` on failure. The persisted provider state is never touched — this is a save-button preflight, not a write. Replaces the chrome.send 'verifyProviderConfig' route.

inputs.name: updates
inputs.description: Partial dict of fields to combine over the stored config for this verification only (api_key, base_url, etc.). Snake_case keys.

inputs.name: keyProviderId
inputs.description: Optional id of a SAVED provider record whose stored (sealed) api_key the probe uses when `updates.api_key` is absent or empty. A user-created custom provider is probed through its dialect's shared backend slot (`providerId`), whose stored config holds whatever key that slot last carried — never the custom record's own; the WebUI only knows the record HAS a key (`hasApiKey`), so it names the record here and the host substitutes the record's key without it ever crossing the bridge. A named record with no stored key probes keyless (the slot's key is dropped). An unknown id fails the probe. Additive: an older host ignores the field and probes with the slot's stored key, as before.
